lines.zh: 我踩着枯黄的草过来，草就断了
lines.en: I come over the yellowed grass, and it snaps.

lines.zh: 我走得很沉，肚子里空得响
lines.en: My steps are heavy; my belly growls hollow.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边低头找东西吃
lines.en: I walk with my head down, looking for food.

lines.zh: 原野上的土是软的，我陷进去一点
lines.en: The plains soil is soft; I sink a little.
My mouth has not closed.
I drag my belly; I cannot go fast.
I walk where the dead grass leans.

lines.zh: 我不看路，我看地上有没有能吃
lines.en: I do not watch the road, but the ground for food.
Every few steps I swallow.
My shadow is short and wide.
I do not go around; I flatten through.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，土都松了
lines.en: The soil loosens where I walk.

lines.zh: 我蹲在枯草里，一直嚼东西
lines.en: I squat in the dead grass, always chewing.
Hungrass blocks cling to my body.

lines.zh: 我的肚子鼓着，里面是空的
lines.en: My belly is round, and empty.

lines.zh: 我不停地咽，什么也没有
lines.en: I keep swallowing, and nothing comes.

lines.zh: 这片原野可以吃的都吃完了
lines.en: Everything edible on these plains is gone.
My teeth are worn flat.
I lower my head and root at the soil.

lines.zh: 我身上有新鲜的草味，很奇怪
lines.en: I smell of fresh grass, oddly.
The wind far off is dry.
I need no sleep; I only want to eat.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，又放回肚子上
lines.en: I lift a hand and put it back on my belly.
This body cannot feed itself.
I chew a dry root.
My eyes are small and turn slowly.

lines.zh: 草从我脚下长出来又枯掉
lines.en: Grass grows and withers under my feet.
The smell in the air is too faint.
I lift my head, mouth still open.
You have a strong smell.

lines.zh: 我先看你的腿，能不能追上
lines.en: I check your legs first: can I catch them?
You are standing still; good.
My belly growls once.
I shift one step forward, slowly.

lines.zh: 我不急，这片地没有出口
lines.en: I am not hurried; this land has no exit.
My fingers are covered in dry grass.
Can that in your hand be eaten?
I tilt my head as if calculating.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着几步软土
lines.en: A few steps of soft soil between us.
You back away, and I shuffle after.
I step back and my belly sways.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我身上，很闷
lines.en: That landed on me, dull and heavy.
I cannot cry out; I can only gasp.

lines.zh: 伤口流出来的东西发黑
lines.en: What seeps from the wound is black.
I press my belly, afraid it will split.
My chewing stops.
That made me hungrier.
I raise my head and look at you.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往后退，退进了枯草
lines.en: I back slowly into the dead grass.
This pain would be worth a meal.
Food, I want food.
Let me bite that thing in your hand.
I keep my mouth open, waiting for you to set it down.
That is not enough; I am still hungry.
I swallow too fast and choke.
I am not picky; I will eat roots.
You retreat slowly, so I come close.
I stretch my hand out far.
Give me a little more.
I am too heavy to move.
That made me swallow.
I step back and my belly sways.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，尘土都起来了
lines.en: We collide and dust rises.

lines.zh: 我抬手推了你一下，很重
lines.en: I push you once, heavily.

lines.zh: 地上的软土陷了两个坑
lines.en: Two hollows sink into the soft ground.

lines.zh: 我没有恶意，我只想闻你
lines.en: No ill intent; I only want to smell you.
The hit left me a bit dazed.
Do not block me from my food.

lines.zh: 原野上还有另一只，我知道
lines.en: There is another on these plains; I know.
Both our bellies are empty.
Searching together beats searching alone.
I do not fight; I let it eat first.

lines.zh: 两只一起走，草倒得更快
lines.en: Two of us walking flattens the grass faster.
We root in the same patch of soil.
It is leaner than me; I leave it some.
We never speak.

lines.zh: 一只要是不动了，另一只还在吃
lines.en: If one stops moving, the other keeps eating.
The plains are big enough for both of us.
I scoop it up and stuff it in.
This tastes of soil.
Two chews and it is down.
I grab a handful and spill half.

lines.zh: 我捡起来看了看，还是吃了
lines.en: I look at it, and eat it anyway.

lines.zh: 我的手太重，捏碎了一些
lines.en: My hands are too heavy; some crumbles.
I press it under my belly.
I pick it up and my belly growls again.
This clump of grass is still fresh.
I save a little and bury it.
Something is moving.
I smell something alive.
You are the only thing that runs here.

lines.zh: 我饿得走不动，可是还得走
lines.en: Too hungry to move, but I must move.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，其实压不下去
lines.en: I try to crouch, but cannot really.
I start to chase, clumsily.
You.

lines.zh: 饥饿原野上，你的气味跑不掉。
lines.en: On the Starved Plains, your scent can't get away.
I follow you, my belly growling.
You run fast, but you will stop.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方，草全断了
lines.en: The grass snaps where I step.
I do not roar; roaring makes me hungrier.
The more you run, the tighter I follow.

lines.zh: 我绕不过去，我就压过去
lines.en: I cannot go around, so I go through.
Your smell never fades.
I wait for you to reach the soft soil.
I am not tired; I am only hungry.
For the last stretch, I charge.
I ram with my head.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的胳膊，往嘴里送
lines.en: I grab your arm and pull it to my mouth.
Clumsy, but heavy.
You are pinned beneath my belly.
Two chews; it is cloth.

lines.zh: 我把你推开，想再咬一口
lines.en: I shove you away to bite again.
My teeth are dull; I bite slowly.
My breathing is loud.
On the Hunger Plains, I am hungry again.
A patch of dead grass falls flat.
I root my way up out of the soft soil.
This is the Starved Plains.
I carry blocks of hungrass on me.

lines.zh: 空气里有草味，也有土味
lines.en: The air smells of grass, and of soil.
The first thing I do is look for food.
I step down and the ground sinks an inch.

lines.zh: 我慢慢站起来，肚子先起
lines.en: I rise slowly, belly first.

lines.zh: 饥饿原野上，草在替我报信。
lines.en: In the hunger fields, the grass reports to me.

lines.zh: 我不记得上次吃饱是什么时候
lines.en: I do not recall the last time I was full.

lines.zh: 这片地只剩我一个在吃
lines.en: Only I am left eating here.

lines.zh: 火烧到鲜草，我拍着往后滚
lines.en: Fire catches the hungrass; I slap it and roll back.
Water pours into my open mouth.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推得滚了两圈
lines.en: The blast rolls me two turns.
An arrow sticks in my belly.
That force keeps me from swallowing.
I have never once been full.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，草都焦了
lines.en: Lightning hits my back; the grass chars.

lines.zh: 脚下没有土，我抓不到东西
lines.en: No soil beneath me; I cannot grip.
